result.title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
result.comment: Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 MLLM 的 3D 空间推理，通过实验说明不同认知层次的空间任务需要不同粒度的几何表征，并提出 SpatialMind：用受文本指令、视觉语义与几何表征共同条件的门控网络，在 LLM 解码器各层自适应调节浅、中、深几何特征的贡献，并加负熵正则防止门控塌缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定多级融合不足」的诊断与逐层按任务调节几何信息注入，直接关系到 LVR 关注的「任务必要视觉与几何信息是否保留在内部状态」，且门控对几何证据的筛选是否造成信息坍缩、与层深和任务难度的关系可供核查。
